question: A train 150 meters long crosses another train of length 100 meters running in the opposite direction in 12 seconds. If the speed of the first train is 60 km/h, estimate the speed of the second train.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 150 + 100 = 250 m

Relative speed = 250 ÷ 12 = 20.83 m/s

Convert first train: 60 km/h = 16.67 m/s

Second train speed = 20.83 − 16.67 = 4.16 m/s

Convert to km/h: 4.16 × 18/5 = 15 km/h

**∴ Answer = 15 km/h**
